newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA INTERBANK MARKET RATES (CHIBOR) END MIXED.
newsitem.headline: CHINA INTERBANK MARKET RATES (CHIBOR) END MIXED.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell slightly to 625 million yuan from 648 million yuan with the one-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was dull with both state banks and non-banking financial institutions trading lightly, dealers said.
Many financial institutions borrowed money on the interbank state debt market becuase the interest rates were lower than those on the interbank money market, traders said.
"This caused volume to continue very thin today," one trader said.
Securities brokerages were major net borrowers due to the strong performance of the stock markets in the past few days, traders said.
Traders said they expected the interbank rates to move narrowly in slow trade on Friday with no fresh news in sight.
